For a Standard Return (e.g., if you're unsatisfied):

The item(s) must be sent back and received at our facility within 90 days of the delivery date to be eligible for a refund.

So, the primary difference is that a standard return requires you to get an authorization and ship the product back at your own expense, whereas for a damaged item, our support team will work with you directly to find a solution.
